start.content: We were there to make sure the sentence was carried out. He claimed to be the Son of God. It was blasphemy.

darkness.content: A strange gloom, yes. But the more significant event happened back at the Temple.

veil.content: At the moment he died, the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The Holy of Holies was exposed. It was a terrifying omen.
